skill.name: WebSocket
skill.description: Implement reliable WebSocket connections with proper reconnection, heartbeats, and scaling.
skill.summary: Reconnection (Always Forget) - Connections drop silently—TCP FIN may never arrive; don't assume `onclose` fires - Exponential backoff: 1s, 2s, 4s, 8s... cap at 30s—prevents thundering herd on server recovery - Add jitter
